issues.title: Learning rate not validated before use
issues.description: The learning rate parameter is read from config but never validated. A zero or negative value will cause the optimiser to produce NaN gradients silently.

issues.title: Dataset path constructed with string concatenation
issues.description: User-supplied dataset path is concatenated with os.getcwd() using '+', which can produce an invalid path if the input contains a leading slash. Use pathlib.Path or os.path.join.

issues.title: Evaluation metric logged but never persisted
issues.description: Accuracy and loss are printed to stdout but not written to any file or metrics store. Results cannot be reproduced or compared across runs.

warnings: This is the built-in OptiLearn demo. Results are pre-recorded — no live analysis was performed.
Reproduce and Debug actions run inside an isolated sandbox (OptiLearn path only).
